studies.title: Studies
studies.body: Create a study, configure its groups and cue pools, generate invite codes, and assign questionnaires. Deleting a study requires typing its exact name to confirm — enrolled participants block deletion until reassigned or removed.

participants.title: Participants
participants.body: Create participants one at a time or in bulk, print or download their token cards, reassign their group, and inspect their progress (surveys, habits, recommendations). Deleting a participant anonymizes their record rather than erasing it outright.

questionnaires.title: Questionnaires
questionnaires.body: Build and edit questionnaires, then assign them to a study. A questionnaire already assigned to a study can't be deleted — remove the assignment first.

cuePools.title: Cue Pools
cuePools.body: Manage the catalog of habit cues offered to participants. Import a CSV to add many cues at once, then assign a cue pool to a study group's cue configuration on the Studies page.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Engagement, habit, and questionnaire-completion metrics per study and group. Use the Studies page's per-study export for a full data download.

backups.title: Backups
backups.body: Trigger a backup, restore from a previous one, or upload/download archives. Every action here is recorded in its own audit trail, separate from the general Audit Log.

participants.fastForwardDesc: Shifts this participant's timeline back so upcoming questionnaire windows, logs and SRHI become due now. Dev-only — the app re-syncs due tasks and reminders on next open.

cuePools.title: Cue Pools
cuePools.subtitle: Manage pre-rated contextual cues for study conditions.
cuePools.qualityHint: High-quality cues are shown to the high_quality condition; low to the low_quality condition.
cuePools.domainHint: The activity domain this cue relates to (e.g. physical_activity).
cuePools.languageHint: The language this cue is written in — used to match participant locale.
cuePools.stabilityHint: How temporally consistent this cue is across days. 5 = very stable.
cuePools.salienceHint: How noticeable or attention-grabbing this cue is. 5 = highly salient.
cuePools.specificityHint: How concrete and specific this cue context is. 5 = very specific.
cuePools.csvHeaderError: CSV must have a header row and at least one data row.
cuePools.importedCues: Imported {count, plural, one {# cue} other {# cues}}

questionnaires.scopeHabitHint: Applies once per habit, anchored to ~5 seconds after each habit is created. Only makes sense once a participant has created a habit.
questionnaires.scopeDonationHint: Never auto-scheduled — offered ad-hoc immediately after a habit donation, only when selected as the study/group's post-donation questionnaire (Studies → Behavior Change).

cueConfigForm.cueCountHint: Single: one cue per habit-formation session. Multi: several cues presented together.
cueConfigForm.cueSourceHint: How cues are sourced — pre-rated from the cue pool library, or chosen by the participant themselves.
cueConfigForm.maxHabitsHint: Caps how many habits a participant can create. Use "1" for single-habit study designs.
cueConfigForm.habitEntryModeHint: Off (free text): participants type and describe their own habit. On (structured): participants pick from a fixed catalog you define instead.
cueConfigForm.allowedBehaviorsHint: Which activity types participants can choose from. Manage the catalog below.
cueConfigForm.emptySelectionWarning: No activities selected — participants will see free-text entry until you pick at least one.
cueConfigForm.noActivityTypes: No activity types in the catalog yet — add some below.

activityTypesManager.title: Activity type catalog (shared across studies)
activityTypesManager.description: Behaviors participants can pick from when a study's habit entry is set to Structured (Details tab). Defaults are informational only. Free-entry (public and free-text) users don't use this catalog.
activityTypesManager.keyAndLabelRequired: Key and English label are required.
activityTypesManager.confirmDelete: Delete activity type "{key}"? This cannot be undone.

fields.nameHint: Used internally; not visible to participants.
fields.recommenderHint: When disabled, participants in this study do not see the recommender screen in the app.
fields.onboardingLabel: Show habit-creation onboarding for this study
fields.onboardingHint: When disabled, participants skip the first-time explainer screens (what a habit is, what cues are) when creating a habit. Can be overridden per group below.
fields.selfHabitHint: When disabled, participants in this study cannot create any habits — the My Habits screen is hidden from the app entirely. Can be overridden per group below.
fields.endDateHint: Optional. When set, the schedule calendar stops projecting occurrences past this date.
fields.remindersMovedHint: Habit, questionnaire, end-of-study, and study-update reminder timing are configured in the Reminders tab.
fields.habitCreationMovedHint: Recommender, onboarding, and habit-creation settings (including structured vs. free-text entry) are configured in the Habit Creation tab.
fields.groupCountHint: Each group is a study condition (e.g. control, intervention). Label them below.
fields.groupCountRemovalWarning: Removing a group moves any participants, codes, and scheduled data in it to the first remaining group.

confirmDelete.message: Delete {name} from the studies list? It will be hidden from the portal, but all of its data is kept in the backend. Download a full copy first if you need it.
confirmDelete.typeNameLabel: Type the study name {name} to confirm:

questionnairesTab.empty: No questionnaires available. Create some in the Questionnaires section.

weeklyActiveRate.title: Weekly Active Rate
weeklyActiveRate.description: % of enrolled participants with ≥1 log in the last 7 days. Click a bar to see participants.

srhiTrajectory.title: SRHI Trajectory
srhiTrajectory.description: Mean habit strength score per week per condition (1–7 scale). Hover points for details.

cumulativeDropout.title: Cumulative Dropout
cumulativeDropout.description: Participants marked as dropped out over time.

questionnaireCompletion.title: Questionnaire Completion
questionnaireCompletion.description: Share of enrolled participants who submitted each questionnaire. Hover for details.
questionnaireCompletion.empty: No questionnaires assigned to this study.

scheduleTab.habitAnchoredHint: First check-in is delivered ~5 seconds after the habit is created.
scheduleTab.continuousHint: Keeps generating check-ins indefinitely; up to 12 upcoming ones are scheduled at a time.
scheduleTab.weeksHint: Week 0 = at enrollment (baseline). Each week is a due date.
scheduleTab.daysHint: Exact days after enrollment. Combined with any weeks above.
scheduleTab.calendarHint: Solid entries are real occurrences for enrolled participants. Dashed entries are a preview of what a new enrollee would see, not yet real participant data.

calendar.noOccurrences: No scheduled occurrences yet. Click a day above or add an assignment below.

scheduleTab.confirmRemove: Remove this assignment? Scheduled entries not yet answered are removed too.

errors.noTimeSlots: Add at least one week or day before saving.

codesTab.allocationDesc: Controls how study codes distribute participants across conditions. Weights are relative — 2 : 1 : 1 : 1 means the first group gets twice as many participants.
codesTab.generateDesc: Codes are tied to the study. Each participant who redeems one is assigned to a group automatically using the allocation above.
codesTab.quantityHintStudy: How many unique enrollment codes to generate in this batch.
codesTab.maxRedemptionsHint: How many participants can redeem each code. Leave blank for unlimited.
codesTab.expiryHint: Codes stop working after this date and time. Leave blank for no expiry.
codesTab.targetedToggleSub: — pin a code to a specific condition
codesTab.groupHint: Participants who redeem this code are assigned directly to this condition, bypassing the allocation weights.
codesTab.targetedQuantityHint: How many unique codes to generate for this condition.

notificationsTab.targetHint: Send to everyone enrolled in this study or to a specific condition group.
notificationsTab.sendTimeHint: Send immediately or schedule for a future date and time.
notificationsTab.reachedNoneNoEnrollment: Reached 0 participants — nobody is enrolled in the selected study/group yet.
notificationsTab.reachedNoneNoDevices: Reached 0 participants — {count} enrolled, but none have a registered device yet. They may not have opened the app or allowed notifications.
notificationsTab.reachedNoneAllFailed: Reached 0 participants — {count} device(s) targeted but every delivery failed. Check the server's Firebase credentials.

cueConfigTab.noGroups: No groups defined. Add groups in the Details tab first.
cueConfigTab.onboardingHint: Overrides the study-level onboarding setting for this group only.
cueConfigTab.selfHabitHint: When off, this group cannot create any habits — the My Habits screen is hidden from the app for this group.

habitCreationTab.recommenderHint: When off, participants in this study do not see the recommender screen in the app.
habitCreationTab.onboardingHint: When off, participants skip the first-time explainer screens (what a habit is, what cues are) when creating a habit.
habitCreationTab.habitCreationHint: When off, participants in this study cannot create any habits — the My Habits screen is hidden from the app entirely.

remindersTab.habitHint: When creating a habit, whether the participant can set a reminder time.
remindersTab.questionnaireHint: The daily clock time a due-questionnaire notification fires.
remindersTab.endOfStudyHint: Whether and when a notification is sent on the study's end date.
remindersTab.studyUpdateHint: A recurring broadcast reminding participants to check the app, plus one-off manual messages.

behaviorChangeTab.habitStackingHint: When on, participants can anchor a new habit onto an existing one ("after I brush my teeth, I will…").
behaviorChangeTab.reminderContentHint: When on, reminder copy uses the participant's implementation intention ("when X, I will Y") instead of generic wording.
behaviorChangeTab.infoOverloadHint: When on, a new habit of a given type only unlocks once an existing one of that type reaches a reminder-frequency tier — preventing overload from too many habits at once.
behaviorChangeTab.donationInputHint: How participants can submit a donated habit: typed text, spoken (transcribed via speech-to-text), or their own choice of either.
behaviorChangeTab.donationQuestionnaireHint: A short questionnaire from the library, offered immediately after every habit donation — e.g. the WHO-5 Well-Being Index. Applies regardless of whether the donation was typed or spoken.

gamificationTab.label: Gamification
gamificationTab.hint: When on, participants earn XP, levels, and praise badges for building their habits. XP and level tuning is configured globally.

restoreAttempts.title: Restore Attempts
restoreAttempts.subtitle: Security monitoring for passphrase-based account restore (POST /restore). Recovery phrases have no server-side secret slowing down a guess, so this view surfaces repeated attempts the rate limiter alone doesn't.
restoreAttempts.flaggedSubtitle: IPs with 3 or more non-successful restore attempts in the last hour.
